stain_calibration.fitted_on: HER2-IHC-40x development tiles (unlabelled) against BCI train

temperature.affects: the reported confidence only, never the predicted class

warnings: Research software. Not clinically validated. Do not use for diagnosis or treatment decisions.
Scores individual tiles only. There is no slide-level or patient-level score.
Experimental. Gains were fitted for one external dataset. Other sites need their own unlabelled calibration, which this package does not provide.
Do not use on BCI tiles: the gains reduce BCI balanced accuracy from 0.875 to 0.407.
Weak on borderline scores: test recall 1+ 0.18, 2+ 0.57 with 2+ precision 0.09.
